run_tensorflow_model_profiling: run a TensorFlow benchmark profiling a named model with a given batch size and output directory
run_model_with_xla: run a TensorFlow model benchmark with XLA JIT compilation enabled for performance profiling
get_model_vision: get a vision model like resnet50 or efficientnet with random input tensors for a given batch size
get_model_nlp: get an NLP model like bert or xlmr with random token input tensors for a given batch size
profile_gpu_memory: profile GPU memory usage for a TensorFlow model and log results to a directory
